en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad, tree‑lined avenue beside a river or canal. On the left is a large, elegant multi‑storey building with shuttered windows, balconies and manicured topiary at the entrance; three women in long dresses and coats walk along the pavement. Farther down the street a horse‑drawn carriage moves away from the camera. On the right, tall leafy trees and gas‑style street lamps line a promenade along the water, with additional grand buildings visible in the distance. The image has the framing, proportions, and style typical of an old photographic postcard. No visible printed caption or writing appears within the image area.
